worldUnit: 1 unit = 1 KayKit Medieval Hexagon native unit. Hex tiles are pointy-top (corners on +-Z), hexSize across the flats (X), tile top at y=0. Characters are 0.9 tall (0.45 x hexSize); a 1-hex KayKit cottage is about 2x a person.
